name: pam
description: Linux-PAM (Pluggable Authentication Modules), a suite of shared libraries that enable local system administrators to choose how applications authenticate users, providing modules such as pam_unix, pam_faillock, pam_limits, and the /etc/pam.d configuration framework.
install: cd Linux-PAM-1.7.2 && DESTDIR="$DESTDIR" meson install -C build --no-rebuild
